title: Tour Lab Orders
summary: What the screen shows: list and board, search, overdue, urgent, filters and an order’s details.

steps.title: Menu → Clinic History → Lab Orders
steps.details: The jobs sent to external labs and the stage each one is in.

steps.title: List or board
steps.details: The list has every filter; the board shows one column per stage and cards are dragged between them.

steps.title: Search
steps.details: By patient, job, lab or order number.

steps.title: Overdue only
steps.details: Orders past their stage’s day limit or past their due date. An order in a final stage is never overdue.

steps.title: Urgent
steps.details: Pending urgent orders; they also come first in the list and on the board.

steps.title: Filters
steps.details: Stage (all, pending or a specific one), lab, doctor, patient, creation dates and sort order (for example, most days in stage).

steps.title: An order
steps.details: Patient, lab, job, doctor, stage, days in stage (red when over the limit) and due date.

steps.title: One column per stage
steps.details: Drag a card to another column to change its stage; it is saved when you drop it.

steps.title: New order
steps.details: Records a new job; it starts in the initial stage.
